intent_en: To demonstrate that wealth concentration among the top Americans has returned to levels seen in the 1920s, paralleling the current rise in stock buybacks.
previous_intent: To illustrate the historical trend of wealth concentration among the top fraction of the United States population, highlighting a return to 1920s levels following a mid-century decline.
narration_support: the American economy looks a lot like it did in the 1920s.
chart_support: Line chart showing the wealth share of the top fraction of the population rising from the late 20th century to levels comparable to the 1920s peak, indicated by a dashed reference line.
evidence_note: The narration explicitly compares the current economy to the 1920s regarding wealth distribution. The chart visualizes this by showing the wealth share of the top holders dropping in the mid-20th century and rising back to 1920s levels by the 2010s.
